text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All right! That time of year has come once 
again! 
The "Baby Umamusume Crawling Race"!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This year, we welcome the "Emperor," 
Symboli Rudolf, 
and her Trainer, 
as our live commentary team!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The vigor and dynamic spirit of the youth 
who bear our future, 
befitting their very first debut— 
I look forward to witnessing it with all 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—This race was created to celebrate the 
healthy growth 
of young horsegirls. Many of the girls in 
the audience 
have probably competed in it at least 
once!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of drama will unfold this year?! 
...Without further ado, let's dive right 
in! 
Introducing the contenders for Race 1—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at Baby Number 1! 
An incredible dash right out of the gate! 
A straight beeline for Mama!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, repaying love with devotion. 
A powerful stride that speaks volumes of 
the bond between mother and child.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way! That's so fast! 
Talk about loving her mama way too much! 
Right, Ai-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, quite an impressive dash. 
...I wonder if we could race once she 
grows up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! You're getting 
competitive with a baby?!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Baby Number 3 is veering wildly off 
course chasing a butterfly! 
Baby Number 5 still hasn't even budged 
from the gate! 
Race 2 has descended into complete and 
utter chaos!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Chaos is simply another facet of racing. 
How one maneuvers through such 
circumstances— 
that is the true test of innate talent.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Look at Number 4! She's got an "M" bib on! 
Go for it! A hundred miles of cheers to 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! Isn't Number 1's mother a graded stakes 
winner...? 
We should definitely keep an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—they're so tiny, yet their unique 
personalities 
are already shining through... I can 
hardly wait to see them bloom.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We all had days like that, didn't we~? 
I'd just love to see baby crawling footage 
of everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so much fun! ...Although! 
Nobody's managed to jump the fence like I 
did 
so far, huh~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Over the fence?! 
While crawling?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to Teio-chan. 
I guess you've been amazing ever since you 
were a baby.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!  
Well, I guess I'm just that awesome~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Well now, everyone. 
You certainly seem to be having a lively 
discussion.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Prez! You've totally run in a crawling 
race 
before too, right, Prez? 
Tell us all about it~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm...? You want to hear about me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf in a crawling race...! 
It had to be, like, whoosh! Zoom! Total 
lightning speed!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it had to be a blowout! Total 
landslide! 
...I mean, not to brag, but I won mine by 
six lengths too♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Considering what the President is capable 
of, even that's an understatement. 
...She was probably faster than the kids 
who were already on two feet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It pains me to dampen your 
expectations, 
but in truth, I never actually entered the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. 
More accurately, you *couldn't* enter, 
could you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
! Sue-san?! 
Why are you here... No, when did you 
return to Japan?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just this morning. When I went looking for 
you, 
they told me you'd be here today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Never mind that, why, why?! 
Why didn't you do the crawling race, 
Prez?!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, you see. 
This little one had an unavoidable 
circumstance...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A mere twenty seconds after Rudolf crawled 
for the first time— 
she was already up on her feet and 
walking.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Twenty seconds after she crawled for the 
first time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: She stood right up...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: *WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAT?!*
choice_data_list:
She was on a whole other level from day 
one...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I could hardly believe my eyes 
back then. 
One moment we were overjoyed she was 
crawling, 
and the next she was already pushing 
herself up.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Our jaws were on the floor. 
And all the while, she just had this 
smug look of satisfaction on her face...

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Tell us more! Details, please!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, gladly. I have plenty of others. 
Like how she was out of diapers 
terrifyingly early...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Su-san... please, spare me. 
Any more would truly be mortifying.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible story... 
If this were a livestream, the chat 
would be an absolute waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still—it is a bit of a shame. I'm sure her 
family 
would have loved to see the president 
in a crawling race, too...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes, quite. ...Yet that is precisely why 
those twenty seconds remain so precious to 
this day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Su-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I was foolishly naive. 
As expected of the "Emperor," Symboli 
Rudolf...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... what on earth could I possibly do 
to top a story like that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's impossible, right?! 
Unless you literally learn how to fly or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...If you wish to challenge me, 
by all means, challenge the me of today.
